items.en: Sanctions Push Russia's Aviation Industry Into Crisis, Forcing Rostec Restructuring
items.nl: Sancties drijven Russische luchtvaartindustrie in crisis, Rostec dwingt tot herstructurering
items.sEn: Ukrainian defense-news outlet Defense Express reports, citing Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU), that Western sanctions have pushed Russia's aviation industry into a structural crisis.
